title: Slip optimization on arbitrary 3D microswimmers: a reduced-dimension and boundary-integral framework
summary: This article presents a computational framework for determining the optimal slip velocity of a microswimmer with arbitrary three-dimensional geometry suspended in a viscous fluid. The objective is to minimize the hydrodynamic power dissipation required to maintain unit speed along the net swimming direction.
